mechanism: Sertraline (SSRI) combined with tranylcypromine (MAOI) causes excessive serotonergic activity leading to serotonin syndrome due to inhibition of serotonin metabolism and reuptake.
action: This combination is contraindicated; allow minimum 14 days washout from tranylcypromine before starting sertraline, or 5 days washout from sertraline before starting tranylcypromine, and monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms.
